title: Sidorenko Conjecture on Bipartite Homomorphism Densities
exact_target: Among graph limits with a fixed edge density, does the constant graphon minimize the homomorphism density of every bipartite graph?

sources.citation: D. Conlon, J. Lee, A. Sidorenko, 'Biregularity in Sidorenko's Conjecture', arXiv:2108.06599 (2021).
